Subject: Next steps: technical deep-dive + procurement items

Hi Anita — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we can converge on the next meeting: 

- Goal: Run a technical deep-dive focused on SSO integration, latency expectations for the inference workload, and procurement checkpoints.
- Stakeholders to include: FinTrack platform/security, procurement, and our solutions engineering + security lead.
- Key asks from FinTrack ahead of the deep dive: SSO metadata (IdP type), expected QPS per tenant, and any compliance evidence you can share.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can you share two 60–90 minute windows next week that work for FinTrack's platform + procurement? We can book a technical workshop (SE + security + platform).
2) Please loop in the SSO contact (ops@fintrack.io or Rahul Menon) so we can confirm IdP details before the call.
3) I attached our quick discovery notes and a suggested demo agenda — if you want edits, tell me and I’ll update.

Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (summary of today)

Thanks — I’ll hold tentative times until I hear back.
